Subject: Internal: BlueHarvest MSA triage + owners (internal only)

Internal note — do not forward without review.

Quick triage of Sarah's redline packet (attached): BlueHarvest_MSA_v1_redlines.docx. I pulled key items that require negotiation or decision: 

- Data residency / scope: they request multi-region hosting (us-west primary + eu fallback). Need architecture confirmation from infra on whether we can commit eu fallback without a Private deployment SLA. Owner: David Kim.
- IP carve-out (section 6): customer proposes broad carve-out. Legal preference: narrow to customer-generated data and customer prompts only. I'll draft a counter. Owner: Kimberly Park.
- Indemnity & liability cap: their redlines try to limit Redwood’s remedies; escalate if they remove cap entirely. Owner: Kimberly Park.
- SLA credits & remedies: they expect uptime credits and a 2-hour incident response for Sev1. Ops to confirm feasibility; if we can’t meet that SLA for hosted tiers, propose canary/dedicated options. Owner: David Kim.
- Procurement flow / invoicing: Net30 is acceptable; need billing address and remit-to. Contracts to create order-form with PO fields. Owner: Marissa Cole.

Suggested timeline: internal draft counters by 2026-11-18 COB, send to customer 2026-11-19 morning. If infra/legal need more time on data residency or SLA, flag by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: legal_triage_checklist.pdf (internal triage notes)

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
